keyframes.description: Walk-in, top shelf, left side. Three quart deli containers. Salsa verde: masking-tape label 'SALSA VERDE  PREP 10/06  USE BY 10/09'. Pico de gallo: label 'PICO  PREP 10/06', no use-by date. Crema: label 'CREMA  USE BY 10/12', no prep date.
Top shelf, right side. Two hotel pans with lids. Carnitas: label 'CARNITAS  PREP 10/05  USE BY 10/08'. Rice: a strip of tape reading only 'RICE' in marker.

Middle shelf, front row. Four containers. Pickled onions: 'PICKLED ONION  PREP 10/01  USE BY 10/15'. Chipotle aioli: 'CHIPOTLE AIOLI  PREP 10/06  USE BY 10/10'. Lime juice: no label at all. Guacamole base: 'GUAC BASE  PREP 10/06', no use-by date.
Middle shelf, back row. Black beans in a 6-quart cambro: 'BLACK BEANS  PREP 10/06  USE BY 10/09'. Mole in a 4-quart cambro: 'MOLE  PREP 10/04  USE BY 10/11'.
Bottom shelf. Chicken thighs marinating on a covered sheet tray: 'CHX THIGH  PREP 10/06  USE BY 10/08'. Shrimp in a lexan bin: label 'SHRIMP  USE BY 10/07', no prep date.
Door rack. Squeeze bottles. Habanero sauce: 'HABANERO  PREP 10/02  USE BY 10/16'. Cilantro oil: tape reading 'CILANTRO OIL' only.
Speed rack by the door. Tortilla dough in a lexan bin: 'TORTILLA DOUGH  PREP 10/06  USE BY 10/07'. Masa in a second lexan bin with no label.
Floor dunnage. Chicken stock in a 22-quart cambro: 'STOCK  PREP 10/05  USE BY 10/09'. Horchata base in a 6-quart cambro: 'HORCHATA  PREP 10/06', no use-by date.
